description: List the tags available on a forum channel (id, name, emoji, emoji_id, moderated flag). Use these IDs with discord_create_forum_post or discord_update_forum_post; manage the tag set with discord_set_forum_tags. The emoji field holds a unicode emoji, or null when the tag has none or uses a custom server emoji. Fails when the channel is not a forum.

forum_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the forum channel to read tags from.

name: discord_get_forum_tags

emoji_id.description: ID of the tag's custom server emoji, or null when it has none.
